title: Life Hub Capability
description: Open generation, closed execution. Shortcuts are pre-worn propose-action shapes; os.propose-action is the universal fallback.

id.description: Stable capability id, e.g. log.entry or os.propose-action

tool_name.description: Anthropic tool name. Defaults to id with dots→underscores.

agents.description: Allowlist of agent slugs. Use ["*"] for every agent.

prompt_one_liner.description: Only text from this capability that enters the system prompt.

legacy_tool.description: Existing chat.mjs tool name this shortcut wraps (Phase 0 migration).
